uniqueness: This is the single finite state/failure matrix for Ticket 25. Packages 25-B through 25-E may add fixture references and observed results by caseId, but must not create another state matrix.

precedenceRules.losers: later rejection, aftercare, refund, stale or reordered observation

precedenceRules.winner: first credible order id for the attempt
precedenceRules.requiredBehavior: Different credible order ids produce CONFLICT_FROZEN; no automatic retry or choice.

precedenceRules.winner: first accepted or rejected decision bound to the original attempt
precedenceRules.losers: duplicate, opposite, stale or reordered manual decision
precedenceRules.requiredBehavior: Accepted publishes; rejected restores editability; neither directly retries.

precedenceRules.losers: cancel success that races after publication
precedenceRules.requiredBehavior: Cancel appends evidence only and cannot restore editing after publication.

cases.precondition: READY article with one admitted regular target
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Article is in 已发布, frozen and removed from active work.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry after accepted.

cases.precondition: FIFO regular group has current article and a queued successor
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Current article enters 需处理/editable and the group proceeds to its next item.
cases.terminalWinner: article-level failure is scoped to current article
cases.retryPolicy: No automatic retry; user may make a new explicit admission after terminal failure.

cases.precondition: Regular group is running and platform/credential/system failure affects the group
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Affected group pauses; other platform groups remain independently runnable.
cases.terminalWinner: group failure pauses only the affected group
cases.retryPolicy: No automatic retry of the failed remote call.

cases.precondition: Regular submission has crossed remote_call_started and transport result cannot be classified
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Article is 需处理 and frozen; affected group is paused; no direct retry command exists.
cases.terminalWinner: original uncertain attempt remains open for manual resolution
cases.retryPolicy: Never automatically retry or replay the remote call.

cases.precondition: Original regular attempt is UNCERTAIN_FROZEN
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: First accepted decision publishes and later opposite decision is retained only as non-authoritative observation.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry after manual resolution.

cases.precondition: Original regular attempt is UNCERTAIN_FROZEN
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: First rejected decision restores editability; late accepted decision cannot publish the old attempt.
cases.retryPolicy: A future target requires explicit new admission after rejection; no replay of the old attempt.

cases.precondition: A regular attempt has already committed publication success
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Exactly one publication-success fact and one immutable archive are exposed.
cases.retryPolicy: Duplicate completion is a no-op observation.

cases.precondition: Article is PUBLISHED_TERMINAL and an older attempt observation arrives
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Published archive remains unchanged; stale observations cannot reopen, downgrade or create a new target.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry or target mutation from stale observations.

cases.precondition: Regular queue contains QUEUED_FROZEN and an in-flight or unstarted item before process restart
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: All regular groups reopen paused; no remote call starts until explicit operator start.
cases.retryPolicy: Do not resume or replay an in-flight remote call automatically.

cases.precondition: Two account groups share one regular platform lock and two different platforms have independent locks
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Same-platform account groups are serialized; different platforms may run concurrently.
cases.retryPolicy: A lost claim is re-read and not replayed as a second claim.

cases.precondition: Paid batch is confirmed and a resource is available
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Article leaves submission queue and is tracked by a real order identity.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry after a credible order id.

cases.precondition: Paid create request was sent but response is timeout/connection loss/missing order id
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Article is 需处理 and frozen; batch does not automatically create another order after restart.
cases.retryPolicy: Never automatically retry the paid create request.

cases.precondition: One paid order-creation attempt has an unresolved result
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Credible order id wins; confirm-no-order cannot remove or overwrite the order fact.
cases.retryPolicy: No new order creation for the same attempt.

cases.precondition: One paid order-creation attempt yields two different credible order ids
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Both safe observations remain; system does not choose an order or retry.
cases.retryPolicy: No automatic retry or overwrite.

cases.precondition: Paid order id has already been bound to the attempt
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Duplicate same-id observation is idempotent and does not create another order history entry.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry.

cases.precondition: Article is already globally published through one target
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Late order observation is recorded in order history without retracting global publication or changing archive content.
cases.retryPolicy: Observation only; no lifecycle retry.

cases.precondition: Paid order is cancelable and no global publication fact exists
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Order history remains and article returns to editable 待投稿.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry of completed cancellation.

cases.precondition: Cancel request is in flight while the remote or another observer establishes publication success
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Cancel evidence is retained, but article stays published and frozen; it is not restored or requeued.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry or restoration after publication.

cases.precondition: Article is being removed while an active queue/uncertain target exists
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Removal or restore does not bypass active-target/frozen invariants; explicit attention is required.
cases.terminalWinner: active target and uncertain freeze guard
cases.retryPolicy: No automatic deletion, restore or new target.

cases.precondition: Article is non-published, terminal and has no active target/order/uncertain fact
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: Article returns to editable state while immutable order/publication evidence, if any, remains retained.
cases.retryPolicy: Repeated restore is idempotent; no remote action.

cases.precondition: An earlier target has explicit non-success terminal state and a new target is explicitly admitted
cases.expectedPublicOutcome: The new target's first success wins globally; old target evidence cannot reopen or replace it.
cases.retryPolicy: No retry from the old target observation.
